On the other hand there are a group of scholars that aver that this type of banking is no different than regular commercial non Islamic banks. Question: Assalamuwalikum, My friend asked one question (i.e) he want to give his shop agreement basis (i.e) he will be get 2 Lakhs from his friend for 2 years(till 2 years his frined will be utilized that shop) After 2 Years my frind will be retrun back 2 Lakhs to his friend. Question is "My frined want to know is it permissible in Islam. Your quick response will be greatly appreciated. Answer ID: 9012 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 2288/1781=H/1429) This dealing of two lakhs or less or more is unlawful as per the Shariah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
